skills.name: ads-incrementality-check
skills.description: Test whether an ad campaign makes the phone ring or only takes credit for calls that would come anyway, using a planned pause and the business's own phone log as the denominator. Use when Performance Max, branded search or Google Business Profile actions claim most of the conversions, when the platform reports leads the business can't find, or before resuming or raising a campaign's budget.

skills.name: ai-search
skills.description: Checks whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google's AI answers name and cite a business for the questions its buyers ask, scores that over the answers actually observed, finds why the winners win, fixes what's fixable on existing pages and listings, and monitors the result. Works for online businesses and, with city-specific question sets that include Google Maps' Ask feature, for local ones. Use when someone asks whether AI assistants recommend them, why a competitor gets recommended instead, or how to get cited.

skills.name: brand-voice
skills.description: Extracts or builds a falsifiable brand voice profile, backed by verbatim evidence from the brand's real content, that every other content skill reads, so output sounds like the brand instead of a model. Use when starting a project, when copy sounds generic or AI-written, when output must match a specific person or brand, or to check recently published content for voice drift.

skills.name: competitive-intel
skills.description: Tear down 3-6 competitors with parallel research agents (homepage messaging, pricing, ads they pay to run, lead magnets, launches, AI-citation presence) and synthesize the exploitable gaps into ./brand/competitors.md. Use when you need to know what competitors actually say and sell before positioning, pricing, or writing copy; also runs a non-interactive diff mode for scheduled competitor watching, an ad-recon mode for paid-ads counter-positioning, and a local mode for service businesses (the top 3 in the map pack and the top paid ads for a service and city, their promises, prices, review pace, and the top complaints across their reviews).

skills.name: content-atomizer
skills.description: Turns one piece of finished content (blog post, newsletter, podcast, video) into platform-native social assets for the 2-3 platforms the brand actually operates, with depth on a few platforms instead of rephrased spray across eight. Use when source content exists and needs distribution, when a post's comments need ranked reply drafts, or when a week of posts should be planned from one source.

skills.name: creative
skills.description: AI creative production engine for product photos, product video, social graphics, talking heads, ad creative, and video ads cut from real or generated footage in code and rendered to MP4 for free, through one tiered pipeline with a vision-QA loop that looks at every asset before you see it. Use whenever visual assets or ad creative need to be made, edited, planned, or batch-produced for a brand or campaign.

skills.name: find-local-clients

skills.name: google-ads-tracking

skills.name: google-business-profile

skills.name: landing-page
